## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix in the sample code

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`fix:`, `feat:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] I ran the prompts from `start-here/` and the checkpoints in `SupportInbox/` end to end and it works with the current tutorial steps
- [ ] No secrets, tenant URLs, access tokens, or personal data are included
- [ ] Eval sets in `SupportInbox/` carry placeholder message IDs (`python fixtures/tools/refresh_evals.py SupportInbox --placeholders`)
- [ ] No binaries, deployments, or other files are added unless legal approval was obtained
- [ ] Changes are limited to the issue being addressed, with no unrelated reformatting
- [ ] If tutorial steps changed, the matching docs page has been updated or a docs change is linked below
